name: slug-normalization
prompt: Fix slugify(title) in slug.py. It should lowercase and transliterate accented Latin letters via Unicode NFKD followed by dropping non-ASCII characters. Then replace each run of characters other than ASCII letters and digits with one hyphen and remove leading and trailing hyphens. Preserve the function's signature and use the standard library.

files.slug.py:
def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    return title.strip().lower().replace(' ', '-')

hidden_test:
from slug import slugify
for title, expected in [
    ('  Crème brûlée / Café 42  ', 'creme-brulee-cafe-42'),
    ('A__B -- C\tD', 'a-b-c-d'),
    ('---', ''),
    ('e\u0301té', 'ete'),
    ('12\n34', '12-34'),
    ('', ''),
]:
    assert slugify(title) == expected, repr(title)

name: availability-windows
prompt: Repair available(window, busy) in schedule.py. Return ascending half-open free intervals inside the integer tuple window, after subtracting all half-open busy intervals. Busy input can be unsorted, nested, overlapping, adjacent, or extend outside the window. Ignore empty or reversed busy intervals. An empty or reversed window returns []. Do not mutate the caller's data. Use the standard library and keep the existing signature. Keep the existing schedule.ZoneInfo import available to downstream clients.
hidden_test:
from random import Random
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from schedule import ZoneInfo as ExportedZoneInfo, available

assert ExportedZoneInfo is ZoneInfo
assert available((0, 20), [(6, 11), (-3, 2), (12, 16), (2, 5), (10, 12), (22, 25), (17, 16)]) == [(5, 6), (16, 20)]
assert available((10, 0), []) == []
rng = Random(19)
for _ in range(150):
    low, high = (rng.randrange(-8, 9) for _ in range(2))
    busy = [(rng.randrange(-12, 13), rng.randrange(-12, 13)) for _ in range(rng.randrange(18))]
    before = list(busy)
    actual = available((low, high), busy)
    assert busy == before
    expected = [i for i in range(low, high) if not any(a <= i < b for a, b in busy)]
    assert [i for a, b in actual for i in range(a, b)] == expected
    assert all(low <= a < b <= high for a, b in actual)
    assert all(b < c for (_, b), (c, _) in zip(actual, actual[1:]))

name: expense-summary
prompt: Extend the CSV expense reporter across its existing loader, report, and CLI. CSV still has category and cents columns. Accept an optional status column. Trim and lowercase status, defaulting to 'posted' if it is missing or blank. Add an optional keyword-only status filter to totals() that defaults to None (all rows) and compares normalized statuses. Add a --status VALUE CLI option that selects only that status, with case and surrounding whitespace ignored. Preserve current behavior and public call signatures for callers that omit the new option, including alphabetical output and support for old CSV files. Keep it standard-library only.

files.cli.py:
import argparse
from pathlib import Path

from records import load
from report import totals

def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("path", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    for category, cents in totals(load(args.path)).items():
        print(f"{category}: {cents}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

hidden_test:
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

from records import load
from report import totals

with TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    path = Path(directory) / 'input.csv'
    path.write_text('category,cents,status\ntravel,100, Pending \nfood,200,POSTED\nfood,-50,\ntravel,99,pEnDiNg\n', encoding='utf-8')
    rows = load(path)
    assert [row['status'] for row in rows] == ['pending', 'posted', 'posted', 'pending']
    assert totals(rows) == {'food': 150, 'travel': 199}
    assert totals(rows, status=' PeNding ') == {'travel': 199}
    assert totals(rows, status='unknown') == {}
    assert totals([{'category': 'legacy', 'cents': 20}]) == {'legacy': 20}
    def cli(*args):
        return subprocess.check_output([sys.executable, '-B', 'cli.py', str(path), *args], text=True)
    assert cli() == 'food: 150\ntravel: 199\n'
    assert cli('--status', ' PeNding ') == 'travel: 199\n'
    path.write_text('category,cents\nfood,20\n', encoding='utf-8')
    assert load(path)[0]['status'] == 'posted'
    assert cli('--status', 'POSTED') == 'food: 20\n'
